example: The magician showed us a clever trick.（魔術師表演了一個巧妙的把戲。）
He bought a new pair of trousers.（他買了一條新長褲。）
The truck carried boxes to the store.（卡車把箱子載到商店。）
He plays the trumpet in the school band.（他在學校樂隊吹小號。）
You can trust her to keep a secret.（你可以信任她保守秘密。）
Please tell the truth.（請說實話。）
The toothpaste tube is almost empty.（牙膏管快空了。）
The car drove through the tunnel.（車子開過隧道。）
We cooked turkey for the holiday dinner.（我們為節日晚餐烤了火雞。）
The turtle moved slowly toward the water.（烏龜慢慢朝水邊移動。）
What type of music do you like?（你喜歡哪種類型的音樂？）
School was canceled because of the typhoon.（因為颱風，學校停課了。）
The old wall looked ugly after the storm.（暴風雨後那面舊牆看起來很難看。）
Bring an umbrella; it may rain.（帶把傘，可能會下雨。）
I packed clean underwear for the trip.（我為旅行打包了乾淨的內衣褲。）
Students wear uniforms at our school.（我們學校的學生穿制服。）
Success depends upon consistent effort. (成功取決於持續努力。)
The upper shelf is hard to reach.（上層架子很難搆到。）
Students become used to digital learning tools. (學生習慣了數位學習工具。)
I used to walk to school every day.（我以前每天走路上學。）
Library users access resources online. (圖書館使用者在線訪問資源。)
Students follow their usual study routine. (學生遵循通常的學習例行程序。)
We went to Hualien during summer vacation.（我們暑假去了花蓮。）
The village sits in a quiet valley.（那個村莊位在安靜的山谷裡。）
Education has immense value for personal development. (教育對個人發展有巨大價值。)
The team celebrated its victory.（隊伍慶祝勝利。）
Educational videos enhance understanding. (教育視頻增強理解。)
Rural villages need educational support. (農村村莊需要教育支持。)
She practices the violin every evening.（她每天晚上練小提琴。）
Each visitor must wear a name tag.（每位訪客都必須戴名牌。）
Reading helps build your vocabulary.（閱讀有助於增加你的字彙量。）
We played volleyball on the beach.（我們在海灘打排球。）
Students vote for class representatives. (學生為班級代表投票。)
Each voter received a ballot.（每位選民都拿到一張選票。）
The belt is too loose around my waist.（這條皮帶在我腰上太鬆了。）
The waiter brought us water.（服務生端水給我們。）
Students wake early for morning classes. (學生為晨課早起。)
I keep my ID card in my wallet.（我把身分證放在錢包裡。）
We hiked to a beautiful waterfall.（我們健行到一座美麗的瀑布。）
We ate cold watermelon after lunch.（我們午餐後吃了冰西瓜。）
Students wave goodbye after graduation. (學生畢業後揮手告別。)
The museum displayed an old weapon behind glass.（博物館把一件古老武器展示在玻璃後。）
They plan to wed in June.（他們計畫六月結婚。）
I wake up early on weekdays.（我平日很早起床。）

meaning: 位於西方的；西方國家的
example: The western sky turned orange at sunset.（西邊的天空在日落時變成橘色。）
My shoes got wet in the rain.（我的鞋子被雨弄濕了。）
A whale rose from the sea.（一頭鯨魚從海面浮起。）
You can choose whatever color you like.（你可以選任何你喜歡的顏色。）
The front wheel of my bike is flat.（我腳踏車的前輪沒氣了。）
Call me whenever you need help.（你需要幫忙時隨時打給我。）
I will follow you wherever you go.（無論你去哪裡，我都會跟著你。）
Please whisper in the library.（在圖書館裡請小聲說話。）
Whoever finishes first can choose a game.（誰先完成，誰就可以選一個遊戲。）
The city plans to widen this road.（市政府計畫拓寬這條路。）
Measure the width of the window.（量一下窗戶的寬度。）

meaning: 瘋狂的；猛烈的；野生的；野生環境
example: We saw wild monkeys in the mountains.（我們在山裡看到野生猴子。）
She is willing to help after class.（她願意下課後幫忙。）
It is too windy to fly a kite today.（今天風太大，不適合放風箏。）
The bird spread its wings and flew away.（鳥張開翅膀飛走了。）
The winner received a gold medal.（獲勝者得到一面金牌。）

meaning: 電線 vt. vi. 拍電報
example: A wire hung loose behind the computer.（電腦後面有一條電線鬆了。）
My grandmother gave me wise advice.（奶奶給了我明智的建議。）
Success comes from within each student. (成功來自每個學生的內心。)
Learning is difficult without proper resources. (沒有適當資源學習很困難。)
The wolf howled in the dark forest.（狼在黑暗的森林裡嚎叫。）
Students wonder about scientific mysteries. (學生對科學奧秘感到好奇。)
We had a wonderful time at the beach.（我們在海邊玩得很開心。）
The child played with a wooden train.（孩子玩著木製火車。）
This sweater is made of wool.（這件毛衣是羊毛做的。）
This book is worth reading.（這本書值得一讀。）
The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.（護士仔細清理傷口。）
School yards provide recreational spaces. (學校院子提供娛樂空間。)

meaning: 青年時期；小伙子；年輕人
example: He spent his youth in a small fishing village.（他的青年時期在一個小漁村度過。）
The zebra has black and white stripes.（斑馬有黑白條紋。）
